question: Should OpenClaw relax the shared tool-result token estimator from 2 to 4 chars/token, or should this bug be fixed by aligning the mid-turn precheck with the provider-boundary projection while preserving the conservative estimator?
rationale: The diff is small, but it changes a shared compaction safety policy used outside the reported mid-turn path, and maintainer feedback on the overlapping PR explicitly asks for proof before accepting that relaxation.

options.title: Preserve safety until proven
options.body: Keep the 2 chars/token estimator for now and land a projection-aligned fix, or require provider/tokenizer evidence and token-dense negative controls before changing the global ratio.

options.title: Accept the ratio relaxation
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the lower estimator pressure if they are satisfied the live/provider evidence covers token-dense tool-result cases.

options.title: Choose a canonical PR first
options.body: Pause or close the overlapping constant-only branches once a maintainer selects the projection PR or a narrower replacement as the canonical landing path.

recommendation.title: Preserve safety until proven
recommendation.body: Keep the 2 chars/token estimator for now and land a projection-aligned fix, or require provider/tokenizer evidence and token-dense negative controls before changing the global ratio.

likelyOwner.reason: This account already left the item-specific maintainer review comment identifying the estimator-policy choice and required proof.
